items.title: Parcel deliveries in Saudi Arabia surpass 54 million in Q3 2026
items.source_excerpt: RIYADH — More than 54 million shipments and parcels were delivered in Saudi Arabia during the third quarter of 2026, the Transport General Authority (TGA) said in its quarterly statistical bulletin, reflecting sustained growth in e-commerce and logistics. According to the bulletin's index of complaints escalated to TGA, Ajex recorded the fewest with one, followed by iMile with two, GFS and Naqel with three each, Starlinks and DHL with four each, and RedBox with five.
